target_background_summary: Database Engineer / Database Administrator with 5+ years supporting Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL, and hybrid cloud database platforms. Experience includes performance tuning, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, monitoring, backup/DR, Azure DevOps deployments, and production incident response at ExxonMobil, Thomson Reuters, and Tiger Analytics.

experience.title: Database Administrator / Database Engineer
truthful_facts: Supported QA and production Microsoft SQL Server environments through monitoring, maintenance, and incident response.
Designed and managed Azure Synapse infrastructure and analytics pipelines, promoting changes through Azure DevOps to production.
Tuned T-SQL queries, indexes, and stored procedures using execution plans and metrics.
Configured SQL Server monitoring utilities, alerts, and thresholds to detect blocking, locking, and performance issues.
Implemented and tested SQL Server backup and restore strategies aligned with RPO/RTO requirements.
Supported high availability and disaster recovery using AlwaysOn Availability Groups and failover testing.
Managed database security controls, permissions, and access policies.
Assisted with database deployments and CI/CD validation for controlled production releases.

experience.title: Cloud Database Engineer
truthful_facts: Supported production SQL Server environments with monitoring, maintenance, and incident support.
Optimized stored procedures, indexing strategies, and query execution plans.
Supported cloud migrations of legacy SQL Server databases to Microsoft Azure.
Implemented disaster recovery architectures targeting sub-hour RTO readiness.
Diagnosed reliability and performance issues using Extended Events, SQL Profiler, and DMV queries.
Collaborated with infrastructure, BI, and development teams on database best practices and security standards.

experience.title: Database Administrator
truthful_facts: Designed and maintained database schemas, normalization models, and indexing strategies.
Executed and validated database backup strategies, recovery testing, and disaster recovery plans.
Monitored SQL Server health and resolved locks, blocking, and concurrency issues.
Tuned T-SQL queries and optimized server configurations for throughput and stability.
Developed PowerShell automation scripts for repetitive administrative tasks.
Coordinated deployment of database change scripts with approval workflows and version control.

projects.name: Azure Synapse / Enterprise BI delivery
truthful_facts: Built and managed Azure Synapse infrastructure and pipelines supporting Enterprise BI data delivery.
Promoted approved Synapse and database changes via Azure DevOps production pipelines.

projects.name: SQL Server HA/DR and monitoring hardening
truthful_facts: Implemented RPO/RTO-aligned backup/restore testing and AlwaysOn Availability Group failover validation.
Reduced monitoring noise and improved incident detection with tuned SQL Server alerts and thresholds.

education.degree: Master of Science – Information Technology Management
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
